Coursera, measured

A reference built from coursera.org as it rendered on 2026-09-29: the public search, course and specialization pages, and a learner's signed-in course home, grades, item pages and My Learning. Every colour, radius, shadow and type style on this page is a CSS custom property generated from tokens.json, which is itself generated from the computed styles in raw/. Hover any swatch or row for the source of its value.

Coursera's design system (CDS) writes every colour as a light-dark() pair, but learners are never offered a dark theme on the captured pages. The dark theme here is a forced flip of those pairs. Component colours that no CDS token covers were measured in light only, so they keep their light value in dark. The theme button at the top right cycles auto, light and dark; auto follows the system.

Type is Source Sans Pro, which Coursera serves under that name from the open-licence Source Sans 3; this page loads Source Sans 3 from Google Fonts. Values not captured are marked in place. Components follow the measurement files; the notes under each say what was read from a crop rather than from computed style.

Palette

Seven hues of fifteen steps, the light side of each --cds-color-* pair. In CDS's dark scheme the ramps invert (blue 800 paints as blue 300 does in light), so the semantic sets below alias whichever step each role paints in that scheme; the ramps themselves do not change with the theme toggle.

Darken and lighten

Ink and paper at fourteen opacities: darken over a checkerboard, lighten over grey 975.

Semantic colours

Each role with its light and dark value side by side, independent of the theme toggle. Role names drop the --cds-color- prefix; the CSS custom property is the name with dots as hyphens.

Typography

One family at 400, 600 and 700. Each style is shown at desktop size; the grey line under its name gives its size below 1024 and below 600 where CDS changes it, and the page applies those changes at those widths. CDS adds letter-spacing on components rather than in the styles: +0.01em on button, tab and chip labels, -0.003em on subtitles.

Tracking added on components

Space and shape

Spacing

The 8px grid (--cds-base) with its halves and multiples.

Radius

Radii with no CDS token

Sizes

Elevation

Three CDS levels plus the three component shadows Coursera draws without a token. Cards on the course pages carry no shadow at all; the search card gains one on hover.

Motion

Buttons, tabs and rows change state instantly; their computed transition is none. Motion is reserved for the card hover shadow, chevrons, and a few reveals. Tap a track to run its curve for the card duration.

Durations

Focus

CDS draws two rings outside the control, a 1px purple ring then a 2px pale-blue one, on an ::after 2px outside with the control's radius. A transparent 1px outline stays for forced-colours mode. Links put the rings straight on the text with a 4px radius; list rows use a plain 2px outline inset 3px; the course page's in-page tabs use a 1px blue outline instead.

Layout

Drawn to scale from the layout tokens at 1440 wide. The container caps at 1440 with 48px side padding (16 below 1024) over a 12-column grid with 32px gutters (16 at 768, 8 at 390).

Course landing page

The hero band is full-bleed; its content and the tab bar sit in the 8-of-12 main column (917.33, so 885.33 of content inside the column padding). The stats card spans all 12 columns and rises 76px into the band.

Search results grid

The results list is 1388 wide with -6px margins, so its container is 1376; each card sits in a 347px cell padded 6px, which gives the 12px gap. The container width is derived from those two measurements.

Course home, three columns

Grades and Course info drop the rail and the main card grows to 1092. The body is fixed at 100vh; the sidebar, main column and rail scroll inside it.

Search field

480 × 44, radius 24, 1px grey-50 edge; hover tints the field blue-25; focus draws the ring on a ::before with the field's 24 radius.

Product card

335 wide, 1px grey-200 edge, radius 16, no shadow at rest. Hover adds the shadow over 300ms on the card curve; the title stays dark in the hover crop. The title link is stretched over the whole card and turns blue-850 when it is the hovered or focused element; focus puts the link ring on the title.
